note: 岚城 (美术规划 §1 岚城: 被风磨圆的白石、铜绿、褪色的红绳; 寻风地带的齐腰草): high-meadow grass, silver-green on top and pale gold at the root, combed one way by the wind; small white, sky-blue and lilac flowers low in the lee of the stones; few trees — squat pines bent flat by the wind, a crooked plum in a hollow, dead stumps bleached white. The region's default flora; a map's own `flora` overrides it key by key.
